about: B-498 calendar sources. Every holiday, early close, weekend, session-hours and lunch-break value in MARKET_CONFIGS (src/index.ts) must appear here, and every entry here must appear in MARKET_CONFIGS; test/b498_calendar_sources.spec.ts enforces both directions. Sources and quotes are copied from two checks of 2026-11-21 (files named under checks), with one exception: the DFM 2026 holiday circulars 06/2026, 08/2026, 09/2026 and 11/2026, read on 2026-11-21 at the instruction of the Lead and marked as such in their entries. Nothing was added from memory. A year listed under years_without_list has no holiday list in the code on purpose, so the engine answers UNKNOWN on its trading days (ruling R5).

XKRX 31 Dec 2026: not listed. KRX had not announced its 2026 year-end closure on any page read (expected from practice in 2024 and 2025, announced 17 and 18 Dec). Also 31 Dec 2027 not listed.

XDFM Friday 4 Dec 2026 now reads OPEN. Under the old Friday and Saturday weekend it read CLOSED; the weekend correction (ruling R4) is what changed it. The day is unresolved: DFM circular 12/2025 of 29/12/2025 does not list it, while UAE public-sector notices give 2 to 4 Dec. In 2025 DFM announced its National Day closure late, in a separate notice: the record shows a Mondo Visione item dated 26/11/2025 (C2 line 41: holiday from Monday 1 December 2025, trading resuming Wednesday 3 December 2025) and DFM circular 11/2025, dated Nov 28, 2025 on DFM's circulars list; whether these are one notice or two is not established. Someone must read DFM's circulars list (https://www.dfm.ae/the-exchange/regulation/circulars) between 26 Nov and 1 Dec 2026, and patch the data if a notice appears; the same applies to 1, 2 and 3 Dec. On 2026-11-21 the newest circular on that list was 12/2026 (New Tick Size Structure, Sep 04, 2026), with no 2026 National Day circular.

Days in the rest of 2026, and the first days of 2027, on which the data is known or suspected to read OPEN after a real early close, or on a closure. Each needs the item named. XNZE 24 and 31 Dec 2026: the NZX memo says "Abbreviated Trading" but gives no close time, so the data reads OPEN to 16:45. XJSE 24 and 31 Dec 2026: no 2026 JSE notice could be read (only a 2025 note of a 12:00 close), so the data reads OPEN to 17:00. XKRX 31 Dec 2026: the year-end closure is not yet announced (expected about 17 or 18 Dec), so the data reads OPEN. XKRX Mon 4 Jan 2027: the regular session is expected to open at 10:00, as on the first trading day of earlier years; the data reads OPEN from 09:00, and the engine has no field for a one-day change of hours. CME (XCBT, XNYM): the abbreviated session of Thu 24 Dec 2026 has no close time, because the Globex holiday-hours table could not be read, so the data reads OPEN to 16:00 CT; the evenings of Thu 24 and Thu 31 Dec from 17:00 CT to midnight also read OPEN although the next day is a listed holiday. In the other direction, the data reads CLOSED from 00:00 CT Thu 26 Nov to 17:00 CT Sun 29 Nov, so Fri 27 Nov, an abbreviated CME trading day, reads CLOSED all day. All of these need CME's table.
The timezone of each venue is not in this file and is not compared by the agreement test (test/b498_calendar_sources.spec.ts). A changed timezone in MARKET_CONFIGS would not be caught.

XDFM 2 and 3 Mar 2026, a fact and not a calendar entry: trading on DFM was suspended on both days by an unscheduled closure. DFM Circular No 03/2026 "Market closure" (Issuance Date 01/03/2026; https://assets.dfm.ae/docs/default-source/circulars/dfm/03-2026-market-closure-final-e.pdf, raw PDF) says: "DFM confirms that trading on the Dubai Financial Market will be suspended effective Monday, 2 March 2026 and on Tuesday 3 March 2026, in line with the Authority’s decision." DFM Circular No 05/2026 "Resumption of Trading" (Issuance Date 03/03/2026; https://assets.dfm.ae/docs/default-source/circulars/05-2026-resumption-of-trading-english.pdf, raw PDF) says: "DFM announces the resumption of trading on the Dubai Financial Market on Wednesday, 4 March 2026." A schedule calendar cannot foresee such a closure, and XDFM was not yet in the code then (it was added on 17 Mar 2026).
